mapper.select: select config.mapping_mode, config.origin_type, config.target_type, config.origin_name, config.target_name, config.conversion, config.default_value, config.date_transform_pattern, config.decimal_reserve_type, config.decimal_reserve_precision, config.decimal_unit_ratio, config.mapping_condition, config.mapping_out_value from b_marketing_data_clean_config config join b_marketing_data_clean_rule rule on config.rule_id = rule.id where rule.api_code = #{apiCode} and rule.clean_type = #{cleanType} and rule.biz_action = #{bizAction} and rule.is_del = 1 and config.is_del = 1
